body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The scripts/test policy and rails suites (check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs, rails-guard-ci.test.mjs, toolkit-floor.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync across 41 sites and manage removals via 57 try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In scripts/test/check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations allocating temp repos to accept t from test(...).
   - Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(repo, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations allocating temp dirs to accept t.
   - Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In scripts/test/toolkit-floor.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update helper functions (makeShim, emptyPathDir, makeGlobalWriterInstall, makeUserPrefixInstall, makeShimLayout, makeFakeWorkspace) to accept t and allocate via tmp(t, prefix).
   - Update tests to pass t to helpers and replace direct mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks, unindenting test bodies.
4. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs, rails-guard-ci.test.mjs, and toolkit-floor.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set.
5. Verification:
   - node --test scripts/test/check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs scripts/test/toolkit-floor.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' scripts/test/check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs scripts/test/toolkit-floor.test.mjs outputs 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 3 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 3 test files.
- AC3 None of the 3 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 node --test scripts/test/check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs scripts/test/toolkit-floor.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(scripts): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit across policy and rails tests
